# FDG4061

> CONSIDER applying `AssemblyFileVersionAttribute` and `Assembly-CopyrightAttribute` to provide additional information about the assembly.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.10 Types and Assembly Metadata.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG4061
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: verified

Message: Apply {0} to the assembly

Library only: the attributes inform the users of an assembly. FDG4061 reports, once per attribute and without a source location, an assembly with externally visible types that lacks AssemblyFileVersionAttribute or AssemblyCopyrightAttribute. SDK-style projects generate the file version, and the copyright only when the Copyright property is set. These assembly-level diagnostics have no source location, so they appear only in build output and never in the Stop hook.
